name: HepcoMotion
summary: Engineering manufacturer that runs a T Level Academy with Exeter College, where learners complete their industry placement one day a week at its Tiverton manufacturing facility.
how_to_apply: For the T Level, apply to Exeter College's Engineering: Machining and Toolmaking Technologies (HepcoMotion T Level Academy) course. For apprenticeships, use the application form on the HepcoMotion careers page.
sites: Head office, Lower Moor Business Park, Tiverton Way, Tiverton|EX16 6TG

name: Apsley Precision Engineering
summary: Precision machining company at High Post near Salisbury that has hosted Wiltshire College T Level industry placements for three years.
how_to_apply: Via Wiltshire College & University Centre's T Level industry placement team (THE BIG Placement Pledge).

name: Rotamec
summary: Repairs and rebuilds electric motors, gearboxes, pumps and fans, with an in-house machine shop and 24-hour mobile engineering team, and takes Weston College T Level learners on industry placements each year.
how_to_apply: Via Weston College's T Level industry placement team.
sites: Cheddar works, Units 3-5 Labourham Farm, Draycott Road|BS27 3RP;Exeter branch, Unit 2 Eagle Way, Sowton Industrial Estate|EX2 7HY

name: Oriole Networks
summary: Engineering employer in Paignton working with fibre optic communications equipment, which hosts South Devon College T Level Design and Development students on paid placements and offered one a Level 6 BSc apprenticeship.
keywords: fibre optics;communications equipment;Paignton;South Devon College;degree apprenticeship
how_to_apply: Via South Devon College's T Level industry placement team.

name: RMB Chivenor (military engineering unit)
summary: Engineering unit at Royal Marines Base Chivenor, North Devon, that hosted four Petroc T Level Engineering students on CAD, fabrication, welding and military vehicle work.
how_to_apply: Via Petroc's T Level industry placement team.
